notes.title: Harriet: From Slave To Hero - Official Release!
notes.notes:
The time has come to announce the release of Harriet: From Slave To Hero. A project, which was born in the university environment and has become a biographical game experience that tells the life of Harriet Tubman, through the video game.

This is the way to show and tell the world the social reality faced by people in an era consumed by discrimination, slavery, and the harsh living conditions and poverty of certain racial groups.

Through a casual, strategy game of approximately two hours, and with a minimalist graphic style, we control tiles in scenarios that narrate the episodes and stages of the protagonist from her adolescence to her adulthood, using stealth as the most important weapon in order to escape alive without being caught.

Remember that the game can already be added to the wishlist, which will notify you once it is available for download. 

Stay tuned, because there is very little time left to go deep into Maryland. 

KKO Team,
